reading.body:
This record is a single OpenStreetMap data-center tag in Poland, not evidence of a large AI facility. It carries no power figure, no operator, and no confirmed capacity.

The entry is named Korbank, which matches a Polish IT company, and the research note concludes the site is most plausibly a corporate office running its own IT with possibly modest hosting for software customers. That is a different class of building from commercial colocation. The only hard geographic fact is its position near Wrocław, 4.4 miles from Copernicus Wrocław Airport.

For AI specifically, this tells us almost nothing. The megawatt value is zero, which here means unrecorded rather than absent, and no grid connection, cooling, or compute capacity is described. A reader tracking the power and building constraints on AI scaling should not count this as supply.

What the data does not cover is the facility's actual existence as a data center, its ownership, or its current operations. The identification rests on a name match, and the research status is exhausted, meaning the check was never completed. Treat it as a plausible small IT site pending confirmation.
